name: 63146 · Saint Louis, MO
findings: ZIP 63146 (Saint Louis) has 209 nonprofit organizations. 81 of them (39%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 69 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (16% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 63146 (Saint Louis) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
